integrity.mathematical_scope: Exact integral and fractional set covering on the 64-by-256 single-deletion incidence relation.
integrity.publication_priority: Comparison of inspected relevant papers and indexed results is best-effort, not proof of novelty.
integrity.verification: Complete symbol-orbit dual certificate, matching fractional primal certificate, explicit integral construction, and standalone exhaustive rational replay.

limitations: Only a four-symbol ordered alphabet, length-four transmitted words and exactly one deletion are covered.
All-length formulas and isomorphism classifications are not claimed.
title: Exact quaternary four-letter deletion covering and its half-integral relaxation
